title: Image Review
summary: Review an image collection one item at a time and retain reversible decisions. Separate passes support manually tagging people, deciding meme/not-meme and reviewing adult-content labels. Machine suggestions help choose a queue but do not silently replace a person’s saved decision.
features: Separate people, meme and adult-content workflows.
Choose source bands, reviewed/unreviewed status, people and machine suggestion filters.
Use large buttons or supported swipe gestures; skip uncertain items.
Keep independent histories, retry a failed save and resume across devices.
Use eligible human meme labels to update a constrained final decision filter.
Export decisions and reversible history; original images remain untouched.
workflows: Choose the intended Review pass before judging an image. Start with a manageable queue such as Borderline rather than treating every suggestion as a verdict.
Inspect the image; enlarge it when the detail matters. If the preview is unavailable, skip instead of guessing.
Use the appropriate positive/negative decision or Skip. Wait for saving to finish before assuming the next item represents a committed choice.
Use Tag people to create/select an appropriate name or nickname and mark the people actually visible.
Use Other people are present for additional unlabelled people, or No people when that is accurate.
People tags are manual. This tool does not perform face recognition or propagate someone’s identity automatically.
Use Undo for the current review channel, then make the intended decision again. Meme, people and adult-content histories are independent.
If a save failed, use the retry state rather than creating conflicting changes in another tab. A stale revision can require refreshing before editing again.
Use filters to revisit previously reviewed items and export the decision history when auditing a batch.
Open the machine-flagged queue to prioritise review, then inspect each image yourself.
Treat model scores as ranking signals rather than calibrated certainty. Your manual label remains a separate record.
Updating the learning filter uses eligible human labels; a failed quality gate should leave a previous valid filter or no active update, not fabricate success.
limits: The app depends on the owner-authenticated gateway and persistent database. No private photographs are used in the shareable demo. No new classifier or private-image scan is run by this documentation work.
